1.title: Integrated Accommodation Reservation Platform
1.description: A mobile-first accommodation platform for searching and booking various types of properties
1.overview: Developed the frontend of a mobile-first platform that integrates accommodation search and booking. Implemented user interfaces based on Figma designs, integrated REST APIs, and designed global state management. Also improved API collaboration with backend developers and extracted common API request logic to enhance code reusability and maintainability.
responsibilities: Developed key UI screens including the home page, accommodation search, property details, map, and My Page based on Figma designs
Implemented mobile-first responsive layouts using React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4
Developed reusable UI components and interactive elements such as sliders and bottom sheets
Extracted common API hooks and request functions for handling REST API requests and responses
Reduced duplicated code by centralizing reusable API request logic
Integrated APIs for search filters, property details, favorites, coupons, points, and reservation history
Organized required API parameters and response fields in advance and shared them with backend developers
Used Zustand to manage authentication, user information, selected properties, and reservation dates globally
Managed selected language information and included it in API request parameters
Integrated Kakao Map API for map-based accommodation search and marker interactions
Implemented a four-language environment using i18next: Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese

2.title: Settlement System Modernization and Full-Stack Development
2.description: An integrated settlement management system for administrators, partners, and merchants
2.overview: Participated in modernizing a legacy settlement system built with Classic ASP using SvelteKit and Node.js. Developed frontend and backend features for administrator, partner, and merchant systems. Separated the SvelteKit frontend from the Express and Sequelize-based REST API server, and implemented API documentation, testing, role-based authentication, and global state management.
responsibilities: Migrated the legacy Classic ASP settlement system to SvelteKit and TypeScript
Separated the SvelteKit frontend and Node.js + Express backend API server
Defined component structures and API data types using TypeScript
Developed RESTful CRUD APIs using Express and Sequelize ORM
Integrated MySQL and implemented settlement data processing logic
Developed role-based data access, search, filtering, and pagination features
Created API specifications using Swagger (OpenAPI)
Shared API request parameters and response structures between frontend and backend teams
Tested API requests and responses using Swagger UI
Implemented role-based authentication for administrators, partners, and merchants
Managed login user information and authentication state using Svelte Store
Separated authentication state from common service settings and application state

3.title: Multi-Domain Platform and Admin System Development
3.description: A multi-domain web platform and administration system managed from a single codebase
3.overview: Developed a multi-domain platform and administration system that operates multiple websites from a single codebase. Used SvelteKit SSR and Server Routes to integrate frontend pages and backend APIs without a separate backend server. Integrated PostgreSQL with Sequelize ORM for server-side data processing and administration dashboard features. Also developed Python scripts to generate QR code and SVG resources.
responsibilities: Developed multi-domain routing using SvelteKit SSR and file-based routing
Built multiple websites within a single SvelteKit application
Implemented server-side API endpoints using +server.ts without a separate Express server
Integrated PostgreSQL with Sequelize ORM
Developed server-side data retrieval and processing APIs
Implemented domain-based routing logic to display different services and data
Developed administration screens for operational data and statistics dashboards
Created Python scripts to generate QR code images for domain-specific URLs

4.title: Automated E-commerce Product Data Collection System
4.description: An automated product data collection and database storage system using Selenium and Requests
4.overview: Developed a Python-based system to automatically collect product information from login-protected shopping websites and store it in a database. Combined Selenium-based login and session management with Requests-based data collection. Implemented data parsing, cleaning, duplicate prevention, progress logging, and automated PostgreSQL storage.
responsibilities: Automated dynamic website access and login using Selenium
Obtained valid authentication tokens and session information during login
Applied authentication information to Requests headers for product data retrieval
Built a hybrid crawler combining Selenium browser automation and Requests
Used regular expressions to extract product information
Processed and cleaned response data into structured JSON
Automatically stored cleaned product data in PostgreSQL
Prevented duplicate collection by checking existing records using unique product identifiers
Logged collection progress and processing results in the terminal
Improved error tracking by recording the last collection stage before interruptions

5.title: Web Service Deployment and Server Infrastructure Operations
5.description: Deployment and operation of SvelteKit and Node.js-based web services
5.overview: Participated in configuring deployment and production environments for SvelteKit and Node.js web services. Worked with Windows Server and IIS, configured network and firewall ports, and managed Node.js application processes using PM2.
responsibilities: Created websites and configured domains and services using IIS Manager on Windows Server
Configured Windows Firewall inbound rules and router port forwarding for external access
Deployed services in an environment using IIS reverse proxy
Configured the Node.js production environment using the SvelteKit build output (build/index.js)
Managed ports, host settings, environment variables, and process options through PM2 ecosystem configuration
Registered Node.js applications with PM2 and configured automatic restarts
Configured log file separation and restart policies to monitor application status and errors

6.title: React-Based Responsive One-Page Website
6.description: A responsive corporate website developed using React with multilingual support
6.overview: Participated in developing a corporate website using React, building a one-page layout and implementing its user interface. Also applied react-i18next to support Korean and multiple language options.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented a one-page website layout using React
Developed web interfaces using HTML and CSS
Implemented responsive layouts for different screen sizes
Organized reusable UI elements into React components
Integrated react-i18next for multilingual translation
Implemented language switching for page content and text

7.title: Payment Solution Admin and User Interface Publishing
7.description: UI publishing for administrator dashboards and user-facing payment pages
7.overview: Participated in a Classic ASP-based payment solution project, contributing to UI publishing for administrator, partner, and merchant dashboards, as well as user-facing payment pages.
responsibilities: Participated in UI publishing for administrator, partner, and merchant dashboards
Implemented HTML and CSS interfaces for data search, viewing, and management screens
Published user-facing payment service pages
Implemented payment page layouts with a user flow similar to PayApp

8.title: E-commerce Website Development and Customization
8.description: Shopping mall UI publishing and GnuBoard theme customization
8.overview: Participated in developing the BerryMall shopping website built with Classic ASP. Worked on user-facing website publishing and customized a GnuBoard-based shopping mall theme.
responsibilities: Participated in UI publishing for the BerryMall shopping website
Implemented shopping mall interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Modified layouts and visual elements of a GnuBoard-based shopping mall theme
Customized existing theme interfaces to meet project requirements

9.title: Flutter-Based Payment Application UI Development
9.description: Reimplementation of an existing web payment service UI as a Flutter mobile application
9.overview: Participated in rebuilding the UI of an existing SvelteKit-based payment service as a Flutter mobile application. Used the existing web interface as a reference to implement mobile screens with Flutter Widgets and tested the layouts using Android Emulator.
responsibilities: Reimplemented existing SvelteKit web screens using Flutter Widgets
Developed mobile-friendly layouts and UI elements
Tested and verified screens using Android Emulator
